ace_step_v1.description: ACE-Step, a fast open-source foundation diffusion based model for music generation that overcomes key limitations of existing approaches and achieves state-of-the-art performance.
ace_step_v1.name: ACE-Step v1.0 3.5B

ace_step_v1_5.description: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo (8 steps) without the 5Hz LM stage. Uses the DiT-only path for faster/leaner runs.
ace_step_v1_5.name: ACE-Step v1.5 Turbo 2B

ace_step_v1_5_turbo_lm_0_6b.description: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo (8 steps) with 0.6B LM, a diffusion-based music generation model with improved conditioning and timbre control. The LM 0.6B triggers a Medium/Weak Think Mode that will increase the Audio Output Quality and Lyrics Matching.
ace_step_v1_5_turbo_lm_0_6b.name: ACE-Step v1.5 Turbo LM_0.6B 2B

ace_step_v1_5_turbo_lm_1_7b.description: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo (8 steps) with 1.7B LM, a diffusion-based music generation model with improved conditioning and timbre control. The LM 1.7B triggers a Medium Think Mode that will increase the Audio Output Quality and Lyrics Matching.
ace_step_v1_5_turbo_lm_1_7b.name: ACE-Step v1.5 Turbo LM_1.7B 2B

ace_step_v1_5_turbo_lm_4b.description: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo (8 steps) with 4B LM, a diffusion-based music generation model with improved conditioning and timbre control. The LM 4B triggers a Strong Think Mode that will increase the Audio Output Quality and Lyrics Matching.
ace_step_v1_5_turbo_lm_4b.name: ACE-Step v1.5 Turbo LM_4B 2B

ace_step_v1_5_xl.description: ACE-Step 1.5 XL Turbo (8 steps) without the 5Hz LM stage. Uses the XL 4B DiT path for higher quality while reusing the ACE-Step 1.5 pipeline, VAE, and text conditioning stack.
ace_step_v1_5_xl.name: ACE-Step v1.5 XL Turbo 4B

ace_step_v1_5_xl_sft.description: ACE-Step 1.5 XL SFT: the quality-focused CFG variant of the XL 4B DiT (acestep-v15-xl-sft). Runs true classifier-free guidance with Adaptive Projected Guidance at a free step count (30 by default) instead of the Turbo distilled 8-step schedule. Highest audio quality in the ACE-Step family; several times slower than Turbo.
ace_step_v1_5_xl_sft.name: ACE-Step v1.5 XL SFT 4B

ace_step_v1_5_xl_sft_lm_4b.description: ACE-Step 1.5 XL SFT with the 4B 5Hz LM: the quality-focused CFG variant of the XL 4B DiT combined with the strongest LM path for maximum quality and lyric matching. Runs true classifier-free guidance at a free step count (30 by default); several times slower than Turbo.
ace_step_v1_5_xl_sft_lm_4b.name: ACE-Step v1.5 XL SFT LM_4B 4B

ace_step_v1_5_xl_turbo_lm_4b.description: ACE-Step 1.5 XL Turbo (8 steps) with 4B LM, combining the XL 4B DiT and strongest 5Hz LM path for maximum quality and lyric matching.
ace_step_v1_5_xl_turbo_lm_4b.name: ACE-Step v1.5 XL Turbo LM_4B 4B

alpha.description: This model successfully generates various scenes with accurate and clearly rendered transparency. Notably, it can synthesize diverse semi-transparent objects, glowing effects, and fine-grained details such as hair. For each video generated you will find a Zip file with the same name that will contain the corresponding RGBA images.
alpha.name: Wan2.1 Alpha v1.0 14B

alpha2.description: Wan-Alpha v2.0 generates transparent videos with fine-grained alpha detail (hair, glow, smoke). For each video, a Zip file with RGBA frames is produced.
alpha2.name: Wan2.1 Alpha v2.0 14B

alpha2_sf.description: Wan-Alpha v2.0 Lightning with transparent video output and RGBA frames zip.
alpha2_sf.name: Wan2.1 Alpha v2.0 Lightning 14B

alpha_sf.description: This model is accelerated by the Lightning / SelfForcing process. It successfully generates various scenes with accurate and clearly rendered transparency. Notably, it can synthesize diverse semi-transparent objects, glowing effects, and fine-grained details such as hair. For each video generated you will find a Zip file with the same name that will contain the corresponding RGBA images.
alpha_sf.name: Wan2.1 Alpha v1.0 Lightning 14B

animate.description: Wan-Animate takes a video and a character image as input, and generates a video in either 'Animation' or 'Replacement' mode. Sliding Window of 81 frames at least are recommeded to obtain the best Style continuity.
animate.name: Wan2.2 Animate 14B

chatterbox.description: Resemble AI's open multilingual TTS with language selection via model mode.
chatterbox.name: TTS Chatterbox Multilingual

chrono_edit.description: This model in an Image Editor that will follow your instructions. It generates internally a video to produce the desired effect on the original image (the result being the End Image). It expects a very specific prompt format. It is why you must absolutely use the Prompt Enhancer that has been tuned for this model.
chrono_edit.name: Wan2.1 Chrono Edit 14B

chrono_edit_distill.description: This model in an Image Editor that will follow your instructions. It generates internally a video to produce the desired effect on the original image (the result being the End Image). It expects a very specific prompt format. It is why you must absolutely use the Prompt Enhancer that has been tuned for this model. This version is accelerated using the Chrono Distill
chrono_edit_distill.name: Wan2.1 Chrono Edit Distill 14B

dramabox_audio.description: Expressive prompt-driven TTS with optional voice reference, integrated through the LTX 2.3 audio stack.
dramabox_audio.name: DramaBox Audio

fantasy.description: The Fantasy Talking model corresponds to the original Wan image 2 video model combined with the Fantasy Speaking module to process an audio Input.
fantasy.name: Fantasy Talking 720p 14B

flf2v_720p.description: The First Last Frame 2 Video model is the official model Image 2 Video model that supports Start and End frames.
flf2v_720p.name: First Last Frame to Video 720p (FLF2V) 14B

flux.description: FLUX.1 Dev is a 12 billion parameter rectified flow transformer capable of generating images from text descriptions.
flux.name: Flux 1 Dev 12B

flux2_dev.description: FLUX.2 Dev is the latest rectified flow transformer from Black Forest Labs for image generation and editing.
flux2_dev.name: Flux 2 Dev 32B

flux2_klein_4b.description: FLUX.2 Klein 4B is a balanced rectified flow transformer for image generation and editing. This version is Cfg & Steps Distilled for very fast generations.
flux2_klein_4b.name: Flux 2 Klein 4B

flux2_klein_9b.description: FLUX.2 Klein 9B is a balanced rectified flow transformer for image generation and editing. This version is Cfg & Steps Distilled for very fast generations.
flux2_klein_9b.name: Flux 2 Klein 9B

flux2_klein_base_4b.description: FLUX.2 Klein 4B is a balanced rectified flow transformer for image generation and editing. This non distilled version is slower but should produce more diverse images.
flux2_klein_base_4b.name: Flux 2 Klein Base 4B

flux2_klein_base_9b.description: FLUX.2 Klein 9B is a balanced rectified flow transformer for image generation and editing. This non distilled version is slower but should produce more diverse images.
flux2_klein_base_9b.name: Flux 2 Klein Base 9B

flux_chroma.description: FLUX.1 Chroma is a 8.9 billion parameters model. As a base model, Chroma1 is intentionally designed to be an excellent starting point for finetuning. It provides a strong, neutral foundation for developers, researchers, and artists to create specialized models..
flux_chroma.name: Flux 1 Chroma 1 HD 8.9B

flux_chroma_radiance.description: FLUX.1 Chroma Radiance 20th of October 2025 version) is a 8.9 billion parameters model. As a base model, Chroma Radiance is intentionally designed to be an excellent starting point for finetuning. It provides a strong, neutral foundation for developers, researchers, and artists to create specialized models.
flux_chroma_radiance.name: Flux 1 Chroma Radiance 8.9B

flux_dev_kontext.description: FLUX.1 Kontext is a 12 billion parameter rectified flow transformer capable of editing images based on instructions stored in the Prompt. Please be aware that Flux Kontext is picky on the resolution of the input image and the output dimensions may not match the dimensions of the input image.
flux_dev_kontext.name: Flux 1 Dev Kontext 12B

flux_dev_kontext_dreamomni2.description: DreamOmni2 is a Multimodal Instruction-based Editing and Generation Model
flux_dev_kontext_dreamomni2.name: Flux 1 DreamOmni2 12B

flux_dev_umo.description: FLUX.1 UMO Dev is a model that can Edit Images with a specialization in combining multiple image references (resized internally at 512x512 max) to produce an Image output. Best Image preservation at 768x768 Resolution Output.
flux_dev_umo.name: Flux 1 UMO 12B

flux_dev_uso.description: FLUX.1 USO Dev is a model that can Edit Images with a specialization in Style Transfers (up to two).
flux_dev_uso.name: Flux 1 USO Dev 12B

flux_krea.description: Cutting-edge output quality, with a focus on aesthetic photography..
flux_krea.name: Flux 1 Dev Krea 12B

flux_schnell.description: FLUX.1 Schnell is a 12 billion parameter rectified flow transformer capable of generating images from text descriptions. As a distilled model it requires fewer denoising steps.
flux_schnell.name: Flux 1 Schnell 12B

flux_srpo.description: By fine-tuning the FLUX.1.dev model with optimized denoising and online reward adjustment, SRPO improves its human-evaluated realism and aesthetic quality by over 3x.
flux_srpo.name: Flux 1 Dev SRPO 12B

flux_srpo_uso.description: FLUX.1 USO SRPO is a model that can Edit Images with a specialization in Style Transfers (up to two). It leverages the improved Image quality brought by the SRPO process
flux_srpo_uso.name: Flux 1 USO SRPO 12B

fun_inp.description: The Fun model is an alternative image 2 video that supports out the box End Image fixing (contrary to the original Wan image 2 video model).
fun_inp.name: Fun InP image2video 14B

fun_inp_1.3B.description: The Fun model is an alternative image 2 video that supports out the box End Image fixing (contrary to the original Wan image 2 video model). The 1.3B adds also image 2 to video capability  to the 1.3B model.
fun_inp_1.3B.name: Fun InP image2video 1.3B

heartmula_oss_3b.description: HeartMuLa open music generation conditioned on lyrics and tags.
heartmula_oss_3b.name: HeartMuLa OSS 3B

heartmula_rl_oss_3b_20260123.description: HeartMuLa RL OSS 3B checkpoint (20260123) with updated codec support. This version should be better at following instructions thanks to a reinforced learning training.
heartmula_rl_oss_3b_20260123.name: HeartMuLa RL OSS (20260123) 3B

hidream_o1.description: HiDream O1 Image is an 8B unified image generation model that works directly in a shared text, pixel, and reference-image token space without a separate VAE or text encoder.
hidream_o1.name: HiDream O1 Image Full 10B

hidream_o1_dev.description: HiDream O1 Image Dev is the distilled 8B HiDream O1 variant tuned for fewer inference steps.
hidream_o1_dev.name: HiDream O1 Image Dev 10B

hunyuan.description: Probably the best text 2 video model available.
hunyuan.name: Hunyuan Video Text2video 720p 13B

hunyuan_1_5_480_i2v.description: HunyuanVideo-1.5 is a video generation model that delivers top-tier quality with only 8.3B parameters, significantly lowering the barrier to usage. This is the Image2video 480p version.
hunyuan_1_5_480_i2v.name: Hunyuan Video 1.5  Image2video 480p 8B

hunyuan_1_5_480_i2v_step_distilled.description: HunyuanVideo-1.5 is a video generation model that delivers top-tier quality with only 8.3B parameters, significantly lowering the barrier to usage. This is the official Step Distilled 480p versionby the Hunyuan Team.
hunyuan_1_5_480_i2v_step_distilled.name: Hunyuan Video 1.5  Image2video 480p Step Distilled 8B

hunyuan_1_5_480_t2v.description: HunyuanVideo-1.5 is a video generation model that delivers top-tier quality with only 8.3B parameters, significantly lowering the barrier to usage. This is the Text2video 480p version.
hunyuan_1_5_480_t2v.name: Hunyuan Video 1.5  Text2video 480p 8B

hunyuan_1_5_480_t2v_lightx2v.description: HunyuanVideo-1.5 is a video generation model that delivers top-tier quality with only 8.3B parameters, significantly lowering the barrier to usage. This is the Text2video 480p version accelerated by lightx2v.
hunyuan_1_5_480_t2v_lightx2v.name: Hunyuan Video 1.5 Text2video 480p Lightx2v 8B

hunyuan_1_5_i2v.description: HunyuanVideo-1.5 is a video generation model that delivers top-tier quality with only 8.3B parameters, significantly lowering the barrier to usage. This is the Image2video 720p version.
hunyuan_1_5_i2v.name: Hunyuan Video 1.5 Image2video 720p 8B

hunyuan_1_5_t2v.description: HunyuanVideo-1.5 is a video generation model that delivers top-tier quality with only 8.3B parameters, significantly lowering the barrier to usage. This is the Text2video 720p version.
hunyuan_1_5_t2v.name: Hunyuan Video 1.5  Text2video 720p 8B

hunyuan_1_5_upsampler.description: HunyuanVideo-1.5 is a video generation model that delivers top-tier quality with only 8.3B parameters, significantly lowering the barrier to usage. This version is a specialized 720p upsampler.
hunyuan_1_5_upsampler.name: Hunyuan Video 1.5  Upsampler 720p 8B

hunyuan_1_5_upsampler_1080.description: HunyuanVideo-1.5 is a video generation model that delivers top-tier quality with only 8.3B parameters, significantly lowering the barrier to usage. This version is a specialized 1080p upsampler.
hunyuan_1_5_upsampler_1080.name: Hunyuan Video 1.5  Upsampler 1080p 8B

hunyuan_avatar.description: With the Hunyuan Video Avatar model you can animate a person based on the content of an audio input. Please note that the video generator works by processing 128 frames segment at a time (even if you ask less). The good news is that it will concatenate multiple segments for long video generation (max 3 segments recommended as the quality will get worse).
hunyuan_avatar.name: Hunyuan Video Avatar 720p 13B

hunyuan_custom.description: The Hunyuan Video Custom model is probably the best model to transfer people (only people for the moment) as it is quite good to keep their identity. However it is slow as to get good results, you need to generate 720p videos with 30 steps.
hunyuan_custom.name: Hunyuan Video Custom 720p 13B

hunyuan_custom_audio.description: The Hunyuan Video Custom Audio model can be used to generate scenes of a person speaking given a Reference Image and a Recorded Voice or Song. The reference image is not a start image and therefore one can represent the person in a different context.The video length can be anything up to 10s. It is also quite good to generate no sound Video based on a person.
hunyuan_custom_audio.name: Hunyuan Video Custom Audio 720p 13B

hunyuan_custom_edit.description: The Hunyuan Video Custom Edit model can be used to do Video inpainting on a person (add accessories or completely replace the person). You will need in any case to define a Video Mask which will indicate which area of the Video should be edited.
hunyuan_custom_edit.name: Hunyuan Video Custom Edit 720p 13B

hunyuan_i2v.description: A good looking image 2 video model, but not so good in prompt adherence.
hunyuan_i2v.name: Hunyuan Video Image2video 720p 13B

hunyuan_t2v_accvideo.description: AccVideo is a novel efficient distillation method to accelerate video diffusion models with synthetic datset. Our method is 8.5x faster than HunyuanVideo.
hunyuan_t2v_accvideo.name: Hunyuan Video Text2video 720p AccVideo 13B

hunyuan_t2v_fast.description: Fast Hunyuan is an accelerated HunyuanVideo model. It can sample high quality videos with 6 diffusion steps.
hunyuan_t2v_fast.name: Hunyuan Video Text2video 720p FastHunyuan 13B

i2v.description: The standard Wan Image 2 Video specialized to generate 480p images. It also offers Start and End Image support (End Image is not supported in the original model but seems to work well)
i2v.name: Wan2.1 Image2video 480p 14B

i2v_2_2.description: Wan 2.2 Image 2 Video model. Contrary to the Wan Image2video 2.1 this model is structurally close to the t2v model. You will need consequently to store Loras for this model in the t2v Lora Folder.
i2v_2_2.name: Wan2.2 Image2video 14B

i2v_2_2_Enhanced_Lightning_v2.description: This custom version of WAN 2.2 I2V accelerated with Lightning has been updated to deliver better prompt comprehension and improved handling of camera angles and cinematic movements. It provides more accurate scene interpretation, smoother transitions, and enhanced control over dynamic.
i2v_2_2_Enhanced_Lightning_v2.name: Wan2.2 Image2video Enhanced Lightning v2 14B

i2v_2_2_Enhanced_Lightning_v2_svi2pro.description: This finetune of WAN 2.2 I2V accelerated with Lightning has been updated to deliver better prompt comprehension and improved handling of camera angles and cinematic movements. It provides more accurate scene interpretation, smoother transitions, and enhanced control over dynamic. The SVI Pro 2 offers potentially unlimited Videos to Continue. It will use either the Start frame or an Anchor image as a Ref. Image to be used across all the windows (or one Anchor Image per Window).
i2v_2_2_Enhanced_Lightning_v2_svi2pro.name: Wan2.2 Image2video SVI 2 Pro Enhanced Lightning v2 14B

i2v_2_2_multitalk.description: The Multitalk module of Wan 2.1 has been combined with the Wan 2.2 image 2 video. It lets you have up to two people have a conversation.
i2v_2_2_multitalk.name: Wan2.2 Multitalk 14B

i2v_2_2_svi2pro.description: Wan 2.2 Image 2 Video Stable Video Infinity Pro 2 offers potentially unlimited Videos to Continue. It will use either the Start frame as a Reference Image or you may provide an Anchor image to be used across all the windows or multiple Anchor Images one per Window.
i2v_2_2_svi2pro.name: Wan2.2 Image2video SVI 2 Pro 14B

i2v_720p.description: The standard Wan Image 2 Video specialized to generate 720p images. It also offers Start and End Image support (End Image is not supported in the original model but seems to work well).
i2v_720p.name: Wan2.1 Image2video 720p 14B

i2v_fusionix.description: A powerful merged image-to-video model based on the original WAN 2.1 I2V model, enhanced using multiple open-source components and LoRAs to boost motion realism, temporal consistency, and expressive detail.
i2v_fusionix.name: Wan2.1 Image2video 480p FusioniX 14B

i2v_nvfp4.description: NVFP4-quantized Lightx2v 4-step finetune for Wan2.1 I2V 480p. For full speed, a sm120+ GPU is needed (RTX 50xx) and the lightx2v kernels must be installed.
i2v_nvfp4.name: Wan2.1 Image2video 480p 14B NVFP4 Lightx2v 4-step

index_tts2.description: IndexTTS2 zero-shot speech synthesis with optional emotion guidance from text or a second reference audio. It supports two-speakers dialogue by starting lines with 'Speaker 1:' and 'Speaker 2:' tags. Emotion is automatically detected in each paragraph or set manually using [].
index_tts2.name: TTS Index TTS 2

infinitetalk.description: The Infinitetalk model is an improved version of Multitalk that supports very long videos. This is the single speaker version. Sliding Window size must be 81 frames to get smooth transitions between shots.
infinitetalk.name: Infinitetalk Single Speaker 480p 14B

infinitetalk_multi.description: The Infinitetalk model is an improved version of Multitalk that supports very long videos. This is the multi speakers version.Sliding Window size must be 81 frames to get smooth transitions between shots
infinitetalk_multi.name: Infinitetalk Multi Speakers 480p 14B

k5_lite_i2v.description: Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite is a line-up of 2B models that generates high-quality HD videos from an input image and English or Russian prompts with controllable camera motion.
k5_lite_i2v.name: Kandinsky 5 Lite I2V SFT 5s 2B

k5_lite_t2v.description: Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite is a line-up of 2B models that generates high-quality HD videos from English and Russian prompts with controllable camera motion.
k5_lite_t2v.name: Kandinsky 5 Lite T2V SFT 5s 2B

k5_lite_t2v_10s_distil.description: Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite is a line-up of 2B models that generates high-quality HD videos from English and Russian prompts with controllable camera motion.
k5_lite_t2v_10s_distil.name: Kandinsky 5 Lite T2V Distilled 10s 2B

k5_lite_t2v_10s_distil_sparse.description: Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite is a line-up of 2B models that generates high-quality HD videos from English and Russian prompts with controllable camera motion.
k5_lite_t2v_10s_distil_sparse.name: Kandinsky 5 Lite T2V Distilled 10s Sparse 2B

k5_lite_t2v_5s_distil.description: Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite is a line-up of 2B models that generates high-quality HD videos from English and Russian prompts with controllable camera motion.
k5_lite_t2v_5s_distil.name: Kandinsky 5 Lite T2V Distilled 5s 2B

k5_pro_i2v.description: Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro is a line-up of 19B models that generates high-quality HD videos from an input image and English or Russian prompts with controllable camera motion.
k5_pro_i2v.name: Kandinsky 5 Pro I2V SFT 5s 19B

k5_pro_t2v.description: Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro is a line-up of 19B models that generates high-quality HD videos from English and Russian prompts with controllable camera motion.
k5_pro_t2v.name: Kandinsky 5 Pro T2V SFT 5s 19B

k5_pro_t2v_10s_sft.description: Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro is a line-up of 19B models that generates high-quality HD videos from English and Russian prompts with controllable camera motion.
k5_pro_t2v_10s_sft.name: Kandinsky 5 Pro T2V SFT 10s 19B

k5_pro_t2v_10s_sft_sparse.description: Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro is a line-up of 19B models that generates high-quality HD videos from English and Russian prompts with controllable camera motion.
k5_pro_t2v_10s_sft_sparse.name: Kandinsky 5 Pro T2V SFT 10s Sparse 19B

kiwi_edit.description: Kiwi-Edit expects Prompt instructionss to Edit an existing video (for instance adding or removing objects or persons). You can reference an image to use it as a background or an object .
kiwi_edit.name: Kiwi Edit Instruct-Reference 5B

kiwi_edit_instruct_only.description: Kiwi-Edit expects Prompt instructionss to Edit an existing video (for instance adding or removing objects or persons).
kiwi_edit_instruct_only.name: Kiwi Edit Instruct-Only 5B

kiwi_edit_reference_only.description: Kiwi-Edit expects Prompt instructionss where you can reference an image to use it as a background or an object .
kiwi_edit_reference_only.name: Kiwi Edit Reference-Only 5B

krea2_raw.description: Krea 2 is the most aesthetic open-source image model available according to its authors. Krea 2 RAW is the undistilled Krea 2 base checkpoint for controlled CFG-guided text-to-image generation.
krea2_raw.name: Krea 2 RAW

krea2_raw_edit.description: Instruction-based image editing with identity preservation using Krea 2 RAW and the full-rank Identity Edit v1.2 LoRA. Supports up to two reference images; RAW is recommended when removing people or objects.
krea2_raw_edit.name: Krea 2 RAW Identity Edit v1.2

krea2_turbo.description: Krea 2 is the most aesthetic open-source image model available according to its authors. Krea 2 Turbo is the distilled few-step Krea 2 checkpoint for fast text-to-image generation.
krea2_turbo.name: Krea 2 Turbo

krea2_turbo_edit.description: Fast instruction-based image editing with identity preservation using Krea 2 Turbo and the full-rank Identity Edit v1.2 LoRA. Supports up to two reference images.
krea2_turbo_edit.name: Krea 2 Turbo Identity Edit v1.2

kugelaudio_0_open.description: KugelAudio open-source text-to-speech with optional voice cloning. You can create a dialogue between two people by providing two audio sources and by starting lines with 'Speaker 1:' and 'Speaker 2:'. You may observe accelerated speech with long speeches; use Manual Split (one empty line) or Auto Split to avoid this effect.
kugelaudio_0_open.name: TTS KugelAudio 0 Open 7B

longcat_avatar.description: LongCat Avatar (single speaker) for audio-driven character video.
longcat_avatar.name: LongCat Avatar Single 13.6B

longcat_avatar_multi.description: LongCat Avatar (multi speaker) for dual-audio driven character video.
longcat_avatar_multi.name: LongCat Avatar Multi 13.6B

longcat_video.description: LongCat Video supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and video continuation with a unified transformer.
longcat_video.name: LongCat Video 13.6B

ltx2_19B.description: LTX-2 generates video up to 20s with an audio soundtrack. Supports start/end keyframes and sliding-window continuation. You can force the audio soundtrack by providing an Audio Prompt.
ltx2_19B.name: LTX-2.0 Dev 19B

ltx2_19B_nvfp4.description: NVFP4-quantized LTX-2 Dev 19B weights. For full speed, a sm120+ GPU is needed (RTX 50xx) and the lightx2v or comfy-kitchen NVFP4 kernels must be installed.
ltx2_19B_nvfp4.name: LTX-2.0 Dev NVFP4 19B

ltx2_22B.description: LTX-2.3 generates video up to 20s with an audio soundtrack. Supports start/end keyframes and sliding-window continuation. You can force the audio soundtrack by providing an Audio Prompt..
ltx2_22B.name: LTX-2.3 Dev 22B

ltx2_22B_10eros.description: Community fine-tune of LTX-2.3 22B (TenStrip/LTX2.3-10Eros) tuned for explicit content. Based on SulphurAI/Sulphur-2-base. Full BF16 checkpoint with FP8 mixed-precision fallback for lower-VRAM systems. Auto-bundles the cond_safe distilled LoRA the author's reference workflow depends on (without it the model produces noisy motion on movement). Available only when Mature Mode is enabled.
ltx2_22B_10eros.name: LTX-2.3 22B 10Eros (Mature)

ltx2_22B_10eros_v14.description: 10Eros v1.4 — the current line of TenStrip/LTX2.3-10Eros (v1.3 'full remix' plus restored explicit prompting and motion control; prioritizes avoiding anatomy confusion). Bundles the rank72_energy distilled LoRA at the reference workflow's per-stage strengths (0.68 stage 1 / 0.38 stage 2) instead of v1's condsafe-at-1.0 pairing, and uses the author's abliterated Gemma-3 12B text encoder (~12.8 GB one-time download) as the reference workflows do — better prompt fidelity for explicit content than the standard QAT encoder. Pairs with the 'Reference pipeline' toggle in Advanced Settings for the closest match to the author's published ComfyUI workflow. Available only when Mature Mode is enabled.
ltx2_22B_10eros_v14.name: LTX-2.3 22B 10Eros v1.4 (Mature)

ltx2_22B_1_1.description: LTX-2.3 Dev checkpoint (22B) using the Distilled 1.1 stage-2 LoRA. Generates video up to 20s with an audio soundtrack, supports start/end keyframes and sliding-window continuation.
ltx2_22B_1_1.name: LTX-2.3 Dev 1.1 22B

ltx2_22B_distilled.description: LTX-2.3 distilled checkpoint (22B) with faster generation.
ltx2_22B_distilled.name: LTX-2.3 Distilled 22B

ltx2_22B_distilled_1_1.description: LTX-2.3 distilled v1.1 checkpoint (22B) with the updated 1.1 transformer. Better audio and visuals. Reuses the existing 2.3 VAE, audio VAE, vocoder, text projection, embeddings connector, and upscalers.
ltx2_22B_distilled_1_1.name: LTX-2.3 Distilled 1.1 22B

ltx2_22B_distilled_1_1_omninft.description: LTX-2.3 distilled v1.1 22B with the OmniNFT RL LoRA pre-applied at weight 1.0 for improved audio/video sync. Same checkpoint as the base distilled 1.1 entry — picks up the LoRA automatically on first use. Per the LoRA authors, audio/video temporal alignment should be noticeably tighter than the base distilled output. Use this when generating videos where dialogue lip-sync and motion-to-sound synchronization matter (Director Mode Music Video / Short Film, Scenema dialogues, etc.).
ltx2_22B_distilled_1_1_omninft.name: LTX-2.3 Distilled 1.1 22B + OmniNFT Sync

ltx2_22B_distilled_fp8.description: FP8 mixed-precision quantized LTX-2.3 distilled checkpoint (22B). Faster generation with ~50% memory reduction.
ltx2_22B_distilled_fp8.name: LTX-2.3 Distilled FP8 22B

ltx2_22B_distilled_gguf_q4_k_m.description: LTX-2.3 distilled GGUF Q4_K_M light checkpoint (22B) without bundled AV connector weights.
ltx2_22B_distilled_gguf_q4_k_m.name: LTX-2.3 Distilled GGUF Q4_K_M Light 22B

ltx2_22B_distilled_gguf_q6_k.description: LTX-2.3 distilled GGUF Q6_K light checkpoint (22B) without bundled AV connector weights.
ltx2_22B_distilled_gguf_q6_k.name: LTX-2.3 Distilled GGUF Q6_K Light 22B

ltx2_22B_distilled_gguf_q8_0.description: LTX-2.3 distilled GGUF Q8_0 light checkpoint (22B) without bundled AV connector weights.
ltx2_22B_distilled_gguf_q8_0.name: LTX-2.3 Distilled GGUF Q8_0 Light 22B

ltx2_22B_fp8.description: FP8 mixed-precision quantized LTX-2.3 dev checkpoint (22B). ~50% memory reduction vs full precision.
ltx2_22B_fp8.name: LTX-2.3 Dev FP8 22B

ltx2_22B_nvfp4.description: NVFP4-quantized LTX-2.3 Dev 22B weights. For full speed, a sm120+ GPU is needed (RTX 50xx) and the lightx2v or comfy-kitchen NVFP4 kernels must be installed.
ltx2_22B_nvfp4.name: LTX-2.3 Dev NVFP4 22B

ltx2_22B_sulphur2_distilled.description: Community fine-tune of LTX-2.3 22B distilled (Winnougan/Sulphur-2-LTX-2.3) tuned for explicit content. FP8 quantized for faster generation with ~50% memory reduction. Available only when Mature Mode is enabled.
ltx2_22B_sulphur2_distilled.name: LTX-2.3 22B Sulphur 2 Distilled FP8 (Mature)

ltx2_25.description: Native LTX-2.5 distilled two-stage workflow with synchronized audio, compatible LTX-2/2.3 LoRAs, first/last and inserted frames, soundtrack or control-video conditioning, and sliding-window continuation. The persistent WanGP/MMGP runtime generates an 8-step half-resolution base, performs learned latent x2 upscaling, then applies a 3-step full-resolution refinement while keeping the loaded model available for faster follow-up generations.
ltx2_25.name: LTX-2.5 — Distilled

ltx2_25_dev.description: Native LTX-2.5 Dev two-stage workflow for maximum quality and prompt adherence, with synchronized audio, first/last and inserted frames, soundtrack or control-video conditioning, compatible LTX-2/2.3 LoRAs, and sliding-window continuation. This optional checkpoint uses the adjustable 30-step quality pipeline rather than the fast distilled schedule.
ltx2_25_dev.name: LTX-2.5 — Dev

ltx2_25_nvfp4.description: Native LTX-2.5 distilled NVFP4 workflow with synchronized audio, first/last and inserted frames, soundtrack or control-video conditioning, compatible LTX-2/2.3 LoRAs, and sliding-window continuation. This optional checkpoint keeps the fast 8-step plus 3-step refinement workflow while reducing transformer memory use on compatible NVIDIA hardware.
ltx2_25_nvfp4.name: LTX-2.5 — Distilled NVFP4

ltx2_distilled.description: LTX-2 distilled checkpoint with faster generation.
ltx2_distilled.name: LTX-2.0 Distilled 19B

ltx2_distilled_gguf_q4_k_m.description: LTX-2 distilled GGUF Q4_K_M checkpoint made by Kijai.
ltx2_distilled_gguf_q4_k_m.name: LTX-2 2.0 Distilled GGUF Q4_K_M 19B

ltx2_distilled_gguf_q6_k.description: LTX-2 distilled GGUF Q6_K checkpoint made by Kijai.
ltx2_distilled_gguf_q6_k.name: LTX-2 2.0 Distilled GGUF Q6_K 19B

ltx2_distilled_gguf_q8_0.description: LTX-2 distilled GGUF Q8_0 checkpoint made by Kijai.
ltx2_distilled_gguf_q8_0.name: LTX-2 2.0 Distilled GGUF Q8_0 19B

ltxv_13B.description: LTX Video is a fast model that can be used to generate very very long videos (up to 1800 frames !).It is recommended to keep the number of steps to 30 or you will need to update the file 'ltxv_video/configs/ltxv-13b-0.9.8-dev.yaml'.The LTX Video model expects very long prompts, so don't hesitate to use the Prompt Enhancer.
ltxv_13B.name: LTX Video 0.9.8 13B

ltxv_distilled.description: LTX Video is a fast model that can be used to generate very long videos (up to 1800 frames !).This distilled version is a very fast version and retains a high level of quality. The LTX Video model expects very long prompts, so don't hesitate to use the Prompt Enhancer.
ltxv_distilled.name: LTX Video 0.9.8 Distilled 13B

lucy_edit.description: Lucy Edit is a video editing model that performs instruction-guided edits on videos using free-text prompts. It supports a variety of edits, such as clothing & accessory changes, character changes, object insertions, and scene replacements while preserving the motion and composition perfectly.
lucy_edit.name: Wan2.2 Lucy Edit v1 5B

lucy_edit_1_1.description: Lucy Edit is a video editing model that performs instruction-guided edits on videos using free-text prompts. It supports a variety of edits, such as clothing & accessory changes, character changes, object insertions, and scene replacements while preserving the motion and composition perfectly.
lucy_edit_1_1.name: Wan2.2 Lucy Edit v1.1 5B

lucy_edit_fastwan.description: Lucy Edit is a video editing model that performs instruction-guided edits on videos using free-text prompts. It supports a variety of edits, such as clothing & accessory changes, character changes, object insertions, and scene replacements while preserving the motion and composition perfectly. This is the FastWan version for faster generation.
lucy_edit_fastwan.name: Wan2.2 Lucy Edit v1 FastWan 5B

lucy_edit_fastwan_1_1.description: Lucy Edit is a video editing model that performs instruction-guided edits on videos using free-text prompts. It supports a variety of edits, such as clothing & accessory changes, character changes, object insertions, and scene replacements while preserving the motion and composition perfectly. This is the FastWan version for faster generation.
lucy_edit_fastwan_1_1.name: Wan2.2 Lucy Edit v1.1 FastWan 5B

lynx.description: The Lynx ControlNet offers State of the Art Identity Preservation. You need to provide a Reference Image which is a close up of a person face to transfer this person in the Video.
lynx.name: Wan2.1 Lynx 14B

minimax_h3.description: Recommended lighter MiniMax H3 First / Last model. Creates video from text, first/last/timed frames, an uploaded soundtrack, or a Control Video soundtrack, with synchronized stereo audio. It can also preserve a Control Video's pictures while generating a new soundtrack. Longer Studio clips carry motion and matching audio through native 14.4-second windows. Voice references belong in H3 Omni. H3 LoRAs, including Turbo, are converted automatically when needed.
minimax_h3.name: H3 First / Last — Pruned

minimax_h3_full.description: Full 33B MiniMax H3 First / Last model. Creates video from text, first/last/timed frames, an uploaded soundtrack, or a Control Video soundtrack, with synchronized stereo audio. It can also preserve a Control Video's pictures while generating a new soundtrack. Longer Studio clips carry motion and matching audio through native 14.4-second windows. Voice references belong in H3 Omni. Turbo works with both Full and Pruned; use Full only when you specifically want its larger checkpoint.
minimax_h3_full.name: H3 First / Last — Full

minimax_h3_fused_turbo.description: Experimental all-in-one MiniMax H3 Frames checkpoint with the FL2VA-to-Ref2VA rank-1024 delta, LightX2V Turbo, Mystic, and native INT8 ConvRot weights already fused. It supports text, start/end/timed frames, audio-driven video, control video, and sliding windows in four model evaluations by default, with an experimental 4-12 step adjustment. SLA sparse attention is enabled by default when the runtime supports it and falls back safely to dense attention.
minimax_h3_fused_turbo.license_name: MiniMax Model License plus upstream component licenses
minimax_h3_fused_turbo.name: H3 Fused 4-Step — Frames (Experimental)

minimax_h3_ref2va.description: Recommended lighter MiniMax H3 Omni model. Ordered image, video, and audio references can guide identity, appearance, motion, scenes, voices, or sound. Multi-window sequence supports AI-planned or manual per-window prompts while carrying recent motion and synchronized stereo audio with the same canonical references. H3 LoRAs, including Turbo, are converted automatically when needed.
minimax_h3_ref2va.name: H3 Omni — Pruned

minimax_h3_ref2va_full.description: Full 33B MiniMax H3 Omni model. Ordered image, video, and audio references can guide identity, appearance, motion, scenes, voices, or sound. Multi-window sequence supports AI-planned or manual per-window prompts while carrying recent motion and synchronized stereo audio with the same canonical references. Turbo works with both Full and Pruned; use Full only when you specifically want its larger checkpoint.
minimax_h3_ref2va_full.name: H3 Omni — Full

minimax_h3_ref2va_fused_turbo.description: Experimental all-in-one MiniMax H3 References checkpoint with the FL2VA-to-Ref2VA rank-1024 delta, LightX2V Turbo, Mystic, and native INT8 ConvRot weights already fused. Ordered image, video, and audio references can guide identity, appearance, motion, voices, and sound in four model evaluations by default, with an experimental 4-12 step adjustment. SLA sparse attention is enabled by default when supported and falls back safely to dense attention.
minimax_h3_ref2va_fused_turbo.license_name: MiniMax Model License plus upstream component licenses
minimax_h3_ref2va_fused_turbo.name: H3 Fused 4-Step — References (Experimental)

minimax_h3_ref2va_singularity.description: Experimental MiniMax H3 Singularity v1.3 for ordered image, video, and audio references. Shares its pinned 21 GB checkpoint with Singularity Frames.
minimax_h3_ref2va_singularity.license_name: Community derivative; review the derivative and MiniMax base-model terms
minimax_h3_ref2va_singularity.name: H3 Singularity — References (Experimental)

minimax_h3_singularity.description: Experimental MiniMax H3 Singularity v1.3 for text, start/end/timed frames, and Control Video editing. Shares its pinned 21 GB checkpoint with Singularity References.
minimax_h3_singularity.license_name: Community derivative; review the derivative and MiniMax base-model terms
minimax_h3_singularity.name: H3 Singularity — Frames (Experimental)

minimax_h3_vdn.description: VideoDeltaNet hybrid attention with trained module and default LoRA. Requires Triton and additional VRAM. Uses the existing FL2VA checkpoint.
minimax_h3_vdn.name: H3 VDN First / Last — Pruned

minimax_h3_vdn_full.description: VideoDeltaNet hybrid attention with trained module and default LoRA. Requires Triton and additional VRAM. Uses the existing FL2VA checkpoint.
minimax_h3_vdn_full.name: H3 VDN First / Last — Full

minimax_h3_voice_audio.description: Voice cloning and general audio with MiniMax H3 Ref2VA Pruned. One or two audio references, a hidden 32x32 video, and audio-only 32 kHz stereo output.
minimax_h3_voice_audio.name: H3 Voice Audio — Pruned

minimax_music3.description: MiniMax-Music3 creates complete stereo songs from lyrics and a detailed music caption, with expressive vocals, evolving arrangements, and long-form structure up to five minutes. Maestro uses WanGP's optimized ConvRot checkpoints with CUDA-graph or vLLM semantic decoding when supported.
minimax_music3.name: MiniMax-Music3

mocha.description: MoCha enables single-character replacement using a source video, a first-frame mask, and up to two clean reference images of a person. It is tuned to generate 81 frames. The second reference frame should be a Face Close up.
mocha.name: Wan2.1 MoCha 14B

moviigen.description: MoviiGen 1.1, a cutting-edge video generation model that excels in cinematic aesthetics and visual quality. Use it to generate videos in 720p or 1080p in the 21:9 ratio.
moviigen.name: MoviiGen 1080p 14B

multitalk.description: The Multitalk model corresponds to the original Wan image 2 video model combined with the Multitalk module. It lets you have up to two people have a conversation.
multitalk.name: Multitalk 480p 14B

multitalk_720p.description: The Multitalk model corresponds to the original Wan image 2 video 720p model combined with the Multitalk module. It lets you have up to two people have a conversation.
multitalk_720p.name: Multitalk 720p 14B

ovi.description: Ovi will generate an Audio soundtrack with the Video. It is specialized in speaking characters. Use the tags <S> and <E> to delimit the speaker words and <AUDCAP> and <ENDAUDCAP> to set the background noise.
ovi.name: Wan2.2 Ovi v1.0 5s 10B

ovi_1_1.description: Ovi will generate an Audio soundtrack with the Video. It is specialized in speaking characters. Use the tags <S> and <E> to delimit the speaker words and use Audio: as a prefix to set the background noise.
ovi_1_1.name: Wan2.2 Ovi v1.1 5s 10B

ovi_1_1_10s.description: Ovi will generate an Audio soundtrack with the Video. It is specialized in speaking characters. Use the tags <S> and <E> to delimit the speaker words and use Audio: as a prefix to set the background noise.
ovi_1_1_10s.name: Wan2.2 Ovi v1.1 10s 10B

ovi_1_1_10s_fastwan.description: Ovi will generate an Audio soundtrack with the Video. It is specialized in speaking characters. Use the tags <S> and <E> to delimit the speaker words and use Audio: as a prefix to set the background noise. This version is accelerated by Fastwan.
ovi_1_1_10s_fastwan.name: Wan2.2 Ovi v1.1 FastWan 10s 10B

ovi_1_1_fastwan.description: Ovi will generate an Audio soundtrack with the Video. It is specialized in speaking characters. Use the tags <S> and <E> to delimit the speaker words and use Audio: as a prefix to set the background noise.
ovi_1_1_fastwan.name: Wan2.2 Ovi v1.1 FastWan 5s 10B

ovi_fastwan.description: Ovi will generate an Audio soundtrack with the Video. It is specialized in speaking characters. Use the tags <S> and <E> to delimit the speaker words and <AUDCAP> and <ENDAUDCAP> to set the background noise. This version of Ovi is accelerated by FastWan
ovi_fastwan.name: Wan2.2 Ovi v1.0 FastWan 5s 10B

phantom_1.3B.description: The Phantom model is specialized in transferring people or objects of your choice into a generated Video. It produces very nice results when used at 720p.
phantom_1.3B.name: Phantom 1.3B

phantom_14B.description: The Phantom model is specialized in transferring people or objects of your choice into a generated Video. It produces very nice results when used at 720p.
phantom_14B.name: Phantom 14B

pi_flux2.description: pi-FLUX.2 is a 4-step distilled version of FLUX.2-dev using the pi-Flow method with Gaussian mixture velocity field prediction. Supports text-to-image and image editing.
pi_flux2.name: pi-FLUX.2 Dev 32B

pi_flux2_nvfp4.description: pi-FLUX.2 using the NVFP4 Flux 2 Dev checkpoint.
pi_flux2_nvfp4.name: pi-FLUX.2 Dev NVFP4 32B

qwen3_tts_base.description: Qwen3 Base voice clone model with reference audio. For two-speaker dialogue, use 'Speaker 1:' and 'Speaker 2:' tags. Use Manual Split (one empty line) or Auto Split to to accelerate generation for very long speeches.
qwen3_tts_base.name: TTS Qwen3 Base (12Hz) 1.7B

qwen3_tts_customvoice.description: Qwen3 Custom Voice with fixed speaker presets and optional instruction control.  Use Manual Split (one empty line) or Auto Split to accelerate generation for very long speeches.
qwen3_tts_customvoice.name: TTS Qwen3 Custom Voice (12Hz) 1.7B

qwen3_tts_voicedesign.description: Qwen3 Voice Design with natural language voice instructions.
qwen3_tts_voicedesign.name: TTS Qwen3 Voice Design (12Hz) 1.7B

qwen_image_20B.description: Qwen Image is generative model that will generate very high quality images. It is one of the few models capable to generate in the image very long texts.
qwen_image_20B.name: Qwen Image 20B

qwen_image_21_7B.description: Unified image generation and editing with up to 10 reference images, control-image transfer, inpainting, LanPaint and outpainting. Start with 40 steps, CFG 4 and 1024px, or select a Viggle Turbo acceleration profile. Native 2K uses roughly 4.2 megapixels and needs more memory. Qwen Research License: non-commercial research/evaluation only; commercial use requires a separate license from Qwen. Only Qwen Image 2.1 7B LoRAs are compatible.
qwen_image_21_7B.name: Qwen Image 2.1 7B

qwen_image_2512_20B.description: Qwen Image 2512 is a 20B image generator that excels at high quality visuals and long text rendering. This December release offers Enhanced Human Realism, Finer Natural Details & Improved Text Rendering.
qwen_image_2512_20B.name: Qwen Image 2512 Release 20B

qwen_image_edit_20B.description: Qwen Image Edit is a generative model that can generate very high quality images with long texts in it. Best results will be at 720p. Use it to edit a Subject or combine multiple Subjects.
qwen_image_edit_20B.name: Qwen Image Edit 20B

qwen_image_edit_20B_gguf_q4_k_m.description: Qwen Image Edit 2511 20B quantized to GGUF Q4_K_M (13.2 GB). Unsloth Dynamic quantization upcasts important layers for accuracy.
qwen_image_edit_20B_gguf_q4_k_m.name: Qwen Image Edit GGUF Q4_K_M 20B

qwen_image_edit_20B_gguf_q6_k.description: Qwen Image Edit 2511 20B quantized to GGUF Q6_K (16.9 GB). Higher quality than Q4, lower VRAM than full model.
qwen_image_edit_20B_gguf_q6_k.name: Qwen Image Edit GGUF Q6_K 20B

qwen_image_edit_20B_gguf_q8_0.description: Qwen Image Edit 2511 20B quantized to GGUF Q8_0 (21.8 GB). Near-lossless quality with significant VRAM savings vs BF16.
qwen_image_edit_20B_gguf_q8_0.name: Qwen Image Edit GGUF Q8_0 20B

qwen_image_edit_2511_20B_fp8.description: FP8 quantized Qwen Image Edit 2511 20B from LightX2V. ~50% memory reduction vs BF16 with minimal quality loss. Uses default inference steps.
qwen_image_edit_2511_20B_fp8.name: Qwen Image Edit (2511) FP8 20B

qwen_image_edit_2511_20B_fp8_lightning_4.description: FP8 quantized Qwen Image Edit 2511 with Lightning 4-step distillation from LightX2V. ~10x faster than base with ~50% memory reduction.
qwen_image_edit_2511_20B_fp8_lightning_4.name: Qwen Image Edit (2511) Lightning 4-Step FP8 20B

qwen_image_edit_2511_20B_fp8_lightning_8.description: FP8 quantized Qwen Image Edit 2511 with Lightning 8-step distillation from LightX2V. Better quality than 4-step with ~50% memory reduction.
qwen_image_edit_2511_20B_fp8_lightning_8.name: Qwen Image Edit (2511) Lightning 8-Step FP8 20B

qwen_image_edit_plus2_20B.description: Qwen Image Edit Plus 2511 improves identity preservation (especially at 1080p) and integrates out of the box popular effects such as religthing and camera changes.
qwen_image_edit_plus2_20B.name: Qwen Image Edit Plus (2511) 20B

qwen_image_edit_plus_20B.description: Qwen Image Edit Plus is a generative model that can generate very high quality images with long texts in it. Best results will be at 720p. This model is optimized to combine multiple Subjects & Objects.
qwen_image_edit_plus_20B.name: Qwen Image Edit Plus (2509) 20B

qwen_image_edit_plus_20B_nunchaku_r128_f.description: Nunchaku SVDQ INT4 weights for Qwen Image Edit 2509 20B. Qwen distilled with lightning 4 steps 251115. For full speed, a sm120+ GPU is needed (RTX 50xx) and the nunchaku kernels must be installed.
qwen_image_edit_plus_20B_nunchaku_r128_f.name: Qwen Image Edit Plus (2509) Nunchaku FP4 r128 20B

qwen_image_edit_plus_20B_nunchaku_r128_i.description: Nunchaku SVDQ INT4 weights for Qwen Image Edit 2509 20B. Qwen distilled with lightning 4 steps 251115. For full speed, the nunchaku kernels must be installed.
qwen_image_edit_plus_20B_nunchaku_r128_i.name: Qwen Image Edit Plus (2509) Nunchaku INT4 r128 20B

qwen_image_layered_20B.description: Qwen Image Layered decomposes an input image into multiple RGBA layers for inherently editable outputs.
qwen_image_layered_20B.name: Qwen Image Layered 20B

recam_1.3B.description: The Recam Master in theory should allow you to replay a video by applying a different camera movement. The model supports only video that are at least 81 frames long (any frame beyond will be ignored)
recam_1.3B.name: ReCamMaster 1.3B

scail.description: SCAIL: Studio-Grade Character Animation. Animates reference image using driving video motion with 3D-consistent pose transfer. Uses NLFPose for accurate 3D skeleton extraction.
scail.name: SCAIL Preview 14B

scail2_14B.description: SCAIL-2: Wan 2.1 character animation with end-to-end reference, pose, and mask conditioning.
scail2_14B.name: SCAIL-2 14B

scail2_14B_fast.description: SCAIL-2 character animation accelerated with the I2V lightx2v CFG-step-distill LoRA: 6 steps and no CFG instead of 40 steps with CFG. Intended for fast Studio/Video animation; Recast uses its dedicated T2V-accelerated model.
scail2_14B_fast.name: SCAIL-2 14B Fast

scail2_14B_recast_fast.description: Recommended SCAIL-2 Recast model. Uses native replacement and multi-reference conditioning with the official I2V LightX fast operating point: 8 steps, shift 1, CFG 1, and UniPC. Recast can also apply Z.ai's official replacement Relighting LoRA.
scail2_14B_recast_fast.name: SCAIL-2 Recast Fast

scenema_audio.companion_error: RuntimeError: SeedVC voice components are not installed (import failed: ImportError("cannot import name 'seedvc' from 'postprocessing' (unknown location)")). Run Update in Pinokio to fetch the seed-vc component (github.com/Blizaine/maestro-seedvc).
scenema_audio.description: Audio-only Scenema TTS/SFX model integrated through the LTX 2.3 stack.
scenema_audio.name: Scenema Audio

sky_df_1.3B.description: The SkyReels 2 Diffusion Forcing model has been designed to generate very long videos that exceeds the usual 5s limit. You can also use this model to extend any existing video.
sky_df_1.3B.name: SkyReels2 Diffusion Forcing 1.3B

sky_df_14B.description: The SkyReels 2 Diffusion Forcing model has been designed to generate very long videos that exceeds the usual 5s limit. You can also use this model to extend any existing video.
sky_df_14B.name: SkyReels2 Diffusion Forcing 540p 14B

sky_df_720p_14B.description: The SkyReels 2 Diffusion Forcing model has been designed to generate very long videos that exceeds the usual 5s limit. You can also use this model to extend any existing video.
sky_df_720p_14B.name: SkyReels2 Diffusion Forcing 720p 14B

standin.description: The original Wan Text 2 Video model combined with the StandIn module to improve Identity Preservation. You need to provide a Reference Image with white background which is a close up of a person face to transfer this person in the Video.
standin.name: Wan2.1 Standin 14B

steadydancer.description: Steady Dancer is a strong animation framework based on Image-to-Video paradigm, ensuring robust first-frame preservation. For a faster processing you may set Condition Guidance to 1.
steadydancer.name: Wan2.1 Steady Dancer 14B

t2v.description: The original Wan Text 2 Video model. Most other models have been built on top of it
t2v.name: Wan2.1 Text2video 14B

t2v_1.3B.description: The light version of the original Wan Text 2 Video model. Most other models have been built on top of it
t2v_1.3B.name: Wan2.1 Text2video 1.3B

t2v_1.3B_nvfp4.description: NVFP4-quantized Lightx2v 4-step finetune for Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B.
t2v_1.3B_nvfp4.name: Wan2.1 Text2video NVFP4 Lightx2v 4-step 1.3B

t2v_fusionix.description: A powerful merged text-to-video model based on the original WAN 2.1 T2V model, enhanced using multiple open-source components and LoRAs to boost motion realism, temporal consistency, and expressive detail.
t2v_fusionix.name: Wan2.1 Text2video FusioniX 14B

t2v_nexus_1.3B.description: The Nexus text2video finetune model is an enhanced small model. The 1.3B Nexus finetune adds a major enhancement to the wan2.1 - 1.3b text2video model. Built on CausVid 1.3b
t2v_nexus_1.3B.name: Wan2.1 Text2video Nexus 1.3B

t2v_sf.description: This model is an advanced text-to-video generation model. The Lightning / SelfForcing process allows the model to generate videos with significantly fewer inference steps (4 or 8 steps) and without classifier-free guidance, substantially reducing video generation time while maintaining high quality outputs.
t2v_sf.name: Wan2.1 Text2video Lightning 14B

ti2v_2_2_fastwan.description: FastWan2.2-TI2V-5B-Full-Diffusers is built upon Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers. It supports efficient 3-step inference and produces high-quality videos at 121×704×1280 resolution
ti2v_2_2_fastwan.name: Wan2.2 TextImage2video FastWan 5B

vace_1.3B.description: The Vace ControlNet model is a powerful model that allows you to control the content of the generated video based of additional custom data : pose or depth video, images or objects you want to see in the video.
vace_1.3B.name: Vace 1.3B

vace_14B.description: The Vace ControlNet model is a powerful model that allows you to control the content of the generated video based of additional custom data : pose or depth video, images or objects you want to see in the video.
vace_14B.name: Vace 14B

vace_14B_2_2.description: There is so far only PARTIAL support of Vace 2.1 which is currently used.
vace_14B_2_2.name: Wan2.2 Vace 14B

vace_14B_cocktail.description: This model has been created on the fly using the Wan text 2 video model and the Loras of FusioniX. The weight of the Detail Enhancer Lora has been reduced to improve identity preservation. Copy the model def in the finetune folder to change the Cocktail composition.
vace_14B_cocktail.name: Vace Cocktail 14B

vace_14B_cocktail_2_2.description: This model has been created on the fly using the Wan text 2.2 video model and the Loras of FusioniX. The weight of the Detail Enhancer Lora has been reduced to improve identity preservation. There is so far only PARTIAL support of Vace 2.1 which is currently used.
vace_14B_cocktail_2_2.name: Wan2.2 Vace Experimental Cocktail 14B

vace_14B_fusionix.description: Vace control model enhanced using multiple open-source components and LoRAs to boost motion realism, temporal consistency, and expressive detail.
vace_14B_fusionix.name: Vace FusioniX 14B

vace_14B_lightning_3p_2_2.description: This finetune uses the Lightning 4 steps Loras Accelerator for Wan 2.2 but extend them to 8 steps in order to insert a CFG phase before the 2 accelerated phases with no Guidance. The ultimate goal is reduce the slow motion effect of these Loras Accelerators.
vace_14B_lightning_3p_2_2.name: Wan2.2 Vace Lightning 3 Phases 14B

vace_14B_sf.description: This model is a combination of Vace and an advanced text-to-video generation model. This approach allows the model to generate videos with significantly fewer inference steps (4 or 8 steps) and without classifier-free guidance, substantially reducing video generation time while maintaining high quality outputs.
vace_14B_sf.name: Vace Self-Forcing 14B

vace_ditto_14B.description: Ditto demonstrates superior instruction-following ability and establish a new SOTA in instruction-based video editing (style, transfer, change of material, etc...). This model expects the Prompt to contain instructions to apply to the whole frames. The Masked Area option is experimental.
vace_ditto_14B.name: Ditto 14B

vace_fun_14B_2_2.description: This is the Fun Vace 2.2 version, that is not the official Vace 2.2
vace_fun_14B_2_2.name: Wan2.2 Vace Fun 14B

vace_fun_14B_cocktail_2_2.description: This model has been created on the fly using the Wan text 2.2 video model and the Loras of FusioniX. The weight of the Detail Enhancer Lora has been reduced to improve identity preservation. This is the Fun Vace 2.2, that is not the official Vace 2.2
vace_fun_14B_cocktail_2_2.name: Wan2.2 Vace Fun Cocktail 14B

vace_lynx_14B.description: The Vace ControlNet model is a powerful model that allows you to control the content of the generated video based of additional custom data : pose or depth video, images or objects you want to see in the video. The Lynx version is specialized in identity transfer, so the last Image Ref should always contain a close up of the Face of a Person to transfer.
vace_lynx_14B.name: Vace Lynx 14B

vace_multitalk_14B.description: Vace control model enhanced using multiple open-source components and LoRAs to boost motion realism, temporal consistency, and expressive detail. And it that's not sufficient Vace is combined with Multitalk.
vace_multitalk_14B.name: Vace Multitalk FusioniX 14B

vace_standin_14B.description: The Vace ControlNet model is a powerful model that allows you to control the content of the generated video based of additional custom data : pose or depth video, images or objects you want to see in the video. The Standin version is specialized in identity transfer, so the last Image Ref should always contain a close up of the Face of a Person to transfer.
vace_standin_14B.name: Vace Standin 14B

viggle_animate.description: Animate a person or object using a control video and one edited frame. Dedicated H3-based Pruned 20B model, three Euler evaluations, automatic 5.2-second windows. Text prompting is not needed.
viggle_animate.name: Viggle Animate — 3-Step

wanmove.description: High-Quality 5s 480p Motion Control: Through scaled training, Wan-Move can generate 5-second, 480p videos with SOTA motion controllability on par with commercial systems such as Kling 1.5 Pro’s Motion Brush, as verified via user studies.
wanmove.name: Wan2.1 Wan-Move 480p 14B

yue2.description: Lyrics and style to 48 kHz stereo songs with optional melody/chord planning and ABC score conditioning. CC BY-NC 4.0 weights.
yue2.name: YuE2 3B

z_image.description: Z-Image is a powerful and highly efficient image generation model with 6B parameters. Z Image Turbe is a distilled version of Z-Image that matches or exceeds leading competitors with only 8 NFEs.
z_image.name: Z-Image Turbo 6B

z_image_base.description: The foundation model behind Z-Image-Turbo. Z-Image focuses on high-quality generation, rich aesthetics, strong diversity, and controllability, well-suited for creative generation, fine-tuning, and downstream development. It supports a wide range of artistic styles, effective negative prompting, and high diversity across identities, poses, compositions, and layouts.
z_image_base.name: Z-Image Base 6B

z_image_control.description: Z-Image Turbo with ControlNet Union supporting Pose, Canny, Depth, and Scribble control types.
z_image_control.name: Z-Image Turbo Fun ControlNet v1 6B

z_image_control2.description: Z-Image Turbo with ControlNet Union supporting Pose, Canny, Depth, and Scribble control types. V2 has more control layers and support inpainting (disabled for the moment).
z_image_control2.name: Z-Image Turbo Fun ControlNet v2 6B

z_image_control2_1.description: Z-Image Turbo with ControlNet Union supporting Pose, Canny, Depth, and Scribble control types. V2.1 has more control layers and support inpainting (disabled for the moment).
z_image_control2_1.name: Z-Image Turbo Fun ControlNet v2.1 6B

z_image_control2_1_8s.description: Z-Image Turbo with ControlNet Union supporting Pose, Canny, Depth, and Scribble control types. V2.1 has more control layers and support inpainting (disabled for the moment).
z_image_control2_1_8s.name: Z-Image Turbo Fun ControlNet v2.1 8 Steps YYY 6B

z_image_nunchaku_r128_fp4.description: Nunchaku SVDQ FP4 weights for Z-Image Turbo. For full speed, a sm120+ GPU is needed (RTX 50xx) and the nunchaku kernels must be installed.
z_image_nunchaku_r128_fp4.name: Z-Image Turbo Nunchaku FP4 (r128) 6B

z_image_nunchaku_r256_int4.description: Nunchaku SVDQ INT4 weights for Z-Image Turbo. For full speed, the nunchaku kernels must be installed.
z_image_nunchaku_r256_int4.name: Z-Image Turbo Nunchaku INT4 (r256) 6B

z_image_twinflow_turbo.description: TwinFlow is a distilled Z-Image Turbo Finetune optimized for 1 to 4 steps Image Generations.
z_image_twinflow_turbo.name: TwinFlow Z-Image Turbo 6B
